thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty P1 — External CDN/TLS failures affecting API reachability (alert PD-98765). Spike of TLS handshake errors from Cloudflare edges; many connections failing with ECONNRESET during handshake. Service: api.redwood.ai. On-call: @anya.

anya: seeing 5xx spikes, mostly 524s and TLS negotiation resets from EU and APAC edges. UI dashboards show 7% error rate across frontends.

anya: initial triage: confirm origin healthy, no deploys in last 30m. k8s pods CPU/memory normal.

mike: confirmed origin: `curl -v https://origin-internal.redwood.net/health` responds 200 from multiple regions. no origin latency.

mike: running curl to Cloudflare public IPs shows TLS handshake failing intermittently:
```
* Connected to 104.16.0.35 (104.16.0.35) port 443 (#0)
* TLS 1.3 (IN), TLS handshake, Client hello (1)
* error:14077410:SSL routines:SSL23_GET_SERVER_HELLO:tlsv1 alert protocol version
* Closing connection 0
curl: (35) error:14077410:SSL routines:SSL23_GET_SERVER_HELLO:tlsv1 alert protocol version
```

jen: customer reports: "API calls started failing ~03:20 UTC, intermittent 502/524. Some retries succeed." High-volume customers in EU.

anya: probable CF edge issue — Cloudflare status indicates partial degradation in EU edge pool (link: https://www.cloudflarestatus.com/incidents). Need mitigation to restore reachability for critical customers.

omar: oncall handoff in 10m — I'm taking lead at 03:30 UTC in case we need infra action.

anya: mitigation plan (short):
- switch traffic away from problematic CF POPs via backup routing / reduce TTLs
- enable direct origin fallback for premium customers (bypass CF)
- reduce client ALPN/HTTP2 to force simpler TLS stacks if that helps (temp)
- open ticket with Cloudflare, reference PD-98765

mike: implementing origin fallback for critical tenants: updating route table to make LB health check bypass CF and route directly to ALB via public IPs for selected customer IP ranges. Patching nginx sticky config to accept direct connections.

mike: command I ran to verify direct path:
```
curl -H "Host: api.redwood.ai" https://34.201.55.100/health -k
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
```

support-bot: creating incident page + customer impact doc: https://redwood.company/incidents/1960123456 (internal). Notifying CS for customers exceeding 10% error.

deploy-bot: deployed temporary route table change to edge-proxy group A -> origin-bypass (canary).

jen: notes for customers: escalation thread being created. We should send initial notification: short description, affected endpoints, mitigation in progress, ETA unknown.

omar: checking if disabling HTTP/2 reduces handshake issues. Pushing a test change to edge-proxy canary to force HTTP/1.1 for requests forwarded through CF.

omar: push logs show decreased handshake failures on canary after forcing HTTP/1.1. Error rate down to ~3% for canary traffic.

anya: good. rolling that change to additional edge-proxies for EU region. Keep an eye on latency -- might increase slightly.

mike: opened Cloudflare support ticket with full handshake dumps and SNI details. case #CF-112233. pinged their on-call Slack.

jen: CS drafted customer note and will send to impacted accounts in EU once we confirm stabilization for 15m.

anya: tracking metrics: error_rate_by_region: EU 7% -> 2.5% after rollouts; APAC 5% -> 4% (still noisy).

mike: increased DNS TTL on the failover records to 30s to avoid flapping. Also created temporary A records pointing to ALB IPs for critical subdomains.

omar: runbook reminder: https://redwood.company/runbooks/cdn-edge-fallback — follow step to add SNI override and toggle `proxy_force_http1`.

anya: next steps: maintain direct fallback for VIP customers, continue rolling HTTP/1.1 for EU, escalate with Cloudflare for a root cause. Prepare to revert once CF announces fix and we see sustained <0.5% errors.

jen: handing external comms to CS. Omar, you're primary for on-call next hour. I'm staying on thread for coord.

omar: taking over. tagging @incident-bot to update PD status -> "acknowledged, mitigation in progress".

incident-bot: PagerDuty PD-98765 status updated: acknowledged.

anya: leaving thread, ping me if CF asks for TLS traces or we need more routing changes. :wave:

jen: customer notification sent to impacted accounts at 03:48 UTC. Template included TODO for follow-up once Cloudflare resolves.

mike: monitoring dashboards show steady decline in erroneous TLS resets. continuing to monitor for 30m then we'll plan rollback.

omar: logging final mitigation actions in incident timeline. Will post postmortem stub in #postmortems once incident closed.

support-bot: remember to include impacted customer list and mitigation timestamps in postmortem.

incident-bot: Incident PD-98765 marked as "under-mitigation".

omar: last checked 03:58 UTC: EU error rate 1.1%, APAC 3%. leaving direct-fallback for premium until CF confirms.

jen: closing customer notifications for now, will update if new information.

omar: marking incident as monitoring — will escalate if >2% error recurs.

incident-bot: thread closed for new pages; legacy alerts will still appear until PD auto-resolve.
